technology.summary: Rules for track setup specify that gates must be no larger than 7 feet wide and 6 feet tall, and flags must be at least 8 feet tall.

technology.name: CDRA 2026 Drone Specification Rules
technology.summary: Drone specifications for the 2026 championship include a maximum frame size of 305mm, max 6S battery cell count, max 6-inch propeller size, and a minimum of 4 LEDs required on all aircraft.

attributes.vtx_requirements: 25mw Raceband or HDZero for National Championship
attributes.led_requirements: Minimum 4 static LEDs, ideally RGB switchable, on aircraft for championship

technology.name: CDRA 2026 Team Rules
technology.summary: Teams have no maximum number of pilots, but only the three fastest pilot scores are used for team qualification.

technology.name: CDRA 2026 Scoring Rules
technology.summary: Pilots submit their fastest three consecutive lap times, which are converted to a point value using the formula 'score = 100 / time', and team scores are the sum of the three highest pilot scores.

attributes.lap_time_recording: spotter with timer or onboard DVR
attributes.team_score_calculation: sum of three highest pilot scores

technology.name: CDRA 2026 Qualification Rules
technology.summary: Qualification for the championship involves the top 10 IRL teams and top 3 Velocidrone teams by the end of February, with remaining spots filled by individual rankings, and requires AMA membership for all participating pilots.
